newsitem.title: UK: Charlton Athletic to float on AIM on March 21.
newsitem.headline: Charlton Athletic to float on AIM on March 21.

text.p: Charlton Athletic, which plays in the First Division of the English soccer league, said on Thursday it plans to join the growing list of UK soccer clubs with a stock market listing.

The club said it would raise 5.5 million stg with a placing and offer of shares at 76p to existing shareholders, season ticket holders and supporters. It will trade on the London Stock Exchange's Alternative Investment Market (AIM) on March 21.
At the offer price the south-east London-based club will be valued at 17.4 million stg. Proceeds will go to increasing the seated capacity of the club's Valley ground to 20,000.
"I am very excited about our flotation," said chairman Richard Murray.

"Not only should it enable The Valley to rank among the best stadiums in the first division, but it will also provide us with a platform to grow our business in the longer term. This marks a crucial step in the history of Charlton Athletic."
The club said its ground's location would produce both short and long term opportunities for the club.
The nominated adviser and broker to the issue is Teather and Greenwood. The offer of 1.3 million shares to existing shareholders is fully underwritten by Richard Murray.
